JotIt by Qishan Lab

Plans and expenses, together.

Capture a thought, check the details and save. JotIt brings schedules, tasks and everyday spending into one app.

One sentence. Two things recorded.

“Meeting tomorrow at 3 pm, lunch today cost 12 dollars.” JotIt turns your words into editable event and expense suggestions. Check the time, amount and details before saving.

Use text, system voice input or on-device image text recognition. Your schedules and expenses stay on your device by default; online AI is off until you choose to enable it.

Capture together

Turn a paragraph into several schedules or expense entries.

See your day

Calendars, tasks, reminders and recurring events in one place.

Track expenses

Record income and spending, then review category and monthly totals.

Stay in control

Review AI suggestions, export records and create local backups.

Start free. Add Pro when you need more AI.

New users receive 100 AI credits for the first 30 days, then 60 per UTC calendar month. Both Pro plans include 600 per subscription month. Standard requests use 1 credit; long or complex requests use 3.

  • Pro Monthly: billed and renewed monthly.
  • Pro Annual: billed and renewed yearly; credits reset monthly.
  • Unused credits do not roll over. Local schedules, expenses, reminders, backup, restore and export remain free.

The reference prices in mainland China are CNY 18/month and CNY 128/year. Your actual local price and currency appear on the App Store purchase screen. Read the subscription and cancellation terms.

Your data, your choice

No app registration is required. Original images are not uploaded. Only necessary text is sent when you allow and initiate online AI. Check upcoming plans using widgets and Apple Watch, and manage exports and local backups from the app.
